chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu Yahya al-Wasiti, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The vegetable of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was endive, and the vegetable of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was basil, and the vegetable of Fatima (peace be upon her) was purslane.
ai.seo_question: What were the favorite vegetables of the Prophet Muhammad, Imam Ali, and Fatima?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the dietary preferences of the Ahl al-Bayt, linking specific vegetables—endive, eggplant, and chard—to the Prophet, Imam Ali, and Fatima al-Zahra respectively. In Shia scholarly tradition, this narration underscores the virtue of simplicity and the spiritual purity associated with the consumption of these foods, often cited in discussions on *adab al-ta'am* (etiquette of eating). It reflects the broader Islamic emphasis on modest sustenance while attributing unique spiritual merit to the practices of the Infallibles.
